mainEntity.name: What does it actually cost to build an AI workflow if I have a very limited budget?

acceptedAnswer.text:
The lowest-cost starting point is to use tools you already have, one clearly defined workflow, and free educational material before paying for a large software stack. Run My AI Biz lists a free starting option for its newsletter and a $9-per-month paid subscription for full weekly issues.

Your total cost may also include AI platform plans, automation services, email software, hosting, scheduling tools, or transaction-related services. Those costs vary by provider and usage, so compare the complete workflow rather than one subscription price.

Key factors:
- Monthly tool and usage charges
- Number of tasks and output volume
- Integration or automation fees
- Time spent monitoring and correcting results

Track the manual minutes saved, error rate, and any new maintenance work for a month. Cancel tools that duplicate existing capabilities or do not improve a measurable bottleneck.

Run My AI Biz provides education and workflow examples that can help you make a more deliberate purchasing decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start with existing tools and one workflow. Run My AI Biz offers a free newsletter option and a $9-per-month paid subscription for full weekly issues; separate AI, automation, email, hosting, and platform costs may also apply. Measure time saved before adding subscriptions.
